{{Quote|Hey! You can't stand there! We're waiting on a freighter, we gotta keep this clear.|Flagman to Cassian Andor|<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />}}
A [[human]] '''flagman''' worked with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at it's [[Great Temple|rebel base]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] in [[2 BBY]]. Shortly after [[Mon Mothma]]'s speech denouncing the [[Galactic Empire]]'s role in the [[Ghorman Massacre]], the flagman had to usher [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] out of the landing area of an expected [[freighter]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Personality and traits==
This flagman had light skin and wore a red [[clothing|vest]] over a tan [[jumpsuit]] and a white [[helmet]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The flagman appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> They were portrayed by [[Daniel Attwell]] in the episode and credited as simply "flagman".<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />
